SAY: I'm happy to take your rotating chore chart and give notice for weekend-only guests under 10, and I'll keep my late nights quiet in shared areas on your work days.

FLX:[cln:Rotating chore chart works for me, a 3 vs 4 gap is small|if tasks are clearly split and we agree on what "tidy" means for the kitchen and common areas]
FLX:[gwk:Weekend-only gatherings under 10 with advance notice|if we can adjust for your deadline or heavy-work weekends]
FLX:[nzl:Low noise in common areas after midnight and on your quiet work days|if you tell me which days and hours you need quiet]
